QuestInfo.name: Supplying Leather Clothes
QuestInfo.0: #b Category: Resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King - Escort, Party Quest#k\r Type: Optional Quest\r\n Content: #bPedro#k says that he has something to ask of you before you leave to prevent the resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King.

0.0: I understand you're going on a journey to reseal Rex. Reminds me of my own youth when I defeated many a Hoblin. You ask me, this whole thing should've been resolved back then. Bah, the others are just too soft. Anyway, if it's not too much trouble, can I ask a favor?

yes.0: I just remembered what #bKyrin#k used to say. She told me that leather clothes are great aboard a Pirate Ship. She said that #b#t4000580:##k is especially useful. Can you bring me 10?

no.0: Was that too much to ask? Please come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Ah, brave one who's traveled to the Ice Ravine. Have you brought back what I asked for?

yes.0: Thank you. I will deliver this to #bKyrin#k.
